visualCharacteristics: Dark, full-bleed hero banner with a background image. Text overlay contains an eyebrow/kicker, a large headline, a short supporting paragraph, and a single CTA button. Minimal content density; text left-aligned over the imagery.
contentPattern: Row 1 = background image; row 2 = rich text (eyebrow + headline + paragraph + CTA link).
usage: Use as the top-of-page feature banner introducing a themed content hub.
